title: Garruk Wildspeaker | Planeswalker
description: Primal huntsman and master of beasts. Learn more about the Planeswalker Garruk Wildspeaker from Magic: The Gathering.

paragraphs.text: Garruk is a towering mountain of a man who turned his back on civilization long ago, preferring a solitary life in the wilds. A tenacious hunter and tracker, Garruk can be a brutal and unforgiving enemy of those who threaten the wilderness he loves. He shares an intuitive connection with beasts, often enlisting them as allies and magically enhancing their size, strength, and ferocity.
